scientific_question: For genuinely unknown three-input nonlinear causal rules, how much exactly identifiable *forecast* information can 2,4,6 public Boolean transition observations provide, and what best-case Brier advantage remains over equally publicly TRAIN-fitted full-rule, independent-bit and compositional competitors? Determine if further prospective learned-cognition experiments have information-theoretic headroom before source birth.
hypothesis: Under compositional priors with latent reusable two-input Boolean gates and an unknown XOR, AND or OR operator, public observations can reduce expected counterfactual Brier loss below the best equally trained full-256-rule posterior. Under a uniform unrestricted 256-rule prior, no predictions about truly unobserved pattern bits are possible; all methods have irreducible expected Brier 0.25.

geometry.gate_atoms: All 16 possible two-input Boolean functions, indexed by their four output bits; each of G(a,b) and H(b,c) has complete identity coverage
geometry.every_unobserved_pattern_target: All 8-k patterns, equally weighted within mask
geometry.public_histories: An already-resolved causal input pattern and its observed Boolean output; no synthetic entity-graph source or original prospective DEV created
geometry.training_information: 64 distinct source-free public TRAIN partial-response cases per source prior, 4 fixed observed patterns each. First 32 compositional-source TRAIN fixture programs guarantee each G- and H-role atom exposed; these PRIVATE fixture identities never enter model fitting. Uniform-full-256 source has no atomic role.

source_priors.uniform_unrestricted_full256: Probability 1/256 for each of 256 truth tables
source_priors.nonuniform_composition_768: Independent positive atom weights: G=(1+((7*i+3)%11)) for i 0..15, H=(1+((5*i+1)%13)) for i 0..15, OP=(5,2,3) for XOR,AND,OR; normalized across 768 programs. Distribution is evaluator-only, not passed to candidate or controls.

trained_competitors.compositional_factors: Public-only 3-iteration smoothed EM for P(G) P(H) P(OP), with strictly positive weights and all 768 program hypotheses, trained separately per source prior
trained_competitors.strong_joint_program: Public-only 3-iteration smoothed EM for full categorical 768-program prior; same public TRAIN and iterations
trained_competitors.strong_full256_rule: Public-only 3-iteration smoothed EM for all 256 unrestricted truth tables, equal TRAIN data
trained_competitors.TRAIN_fitted_independent_Beta: Public-only per-bit Beta(2,2) marginal trained on all publicly observed pattern bits
trained_competitors.uniform_unrestricted_exact: Independent uniform 256-rule posterior with P=0.5 for every unobserved Boolean input
trained_competitors.oracle: Evaluator-only exact Bayes posterior from source-private true prior, an unattainable upper bound on expected forecast performance. Never pass this prior or evaluation response outcomes to trained candidates.

exact_enumeration.true_distribution: Project weighted 768 programs onto 256 eight-bit tables, preserving latent program multiplicities; or use exact uniform 256 law distribution
exact_enumeration.observation_groups: For every k and every observation mask, enumerate every possible observed response signature with positive prior probability. Sum exact event probability and posterior target-bit conditional mean.
exact_enumeration.expected_brier: For each unseen target with true posterior p and model prediction q, exact expected Brier = p*(1-q)^2+(1-p)*q^2. Oracle Bayes risk p*(1-p). No sampling uncertainty in final expectation.
exact_enumeration.identifiability: Report exactly realizable 3-input Boolean truth tables, syntactically observationally indistinguishable programs, conditional entropy/information gain and fraction of event-target combinations whose predictive outcome is deterministically entailed by all full 256 rules (always zero for unobserved bit under unrestricted consistency).
exact_enumeration.validation: Independent direct probability check against a second implementation of the oracle conditioning using program-space rather than weighted 256-table grouping, at least one row per prior×k; posterior masses sum to one; Bayes risk <= any trained competitor; uniform unrestricted prior produces Brier 0.25 and zero mutual information on every unseen bit.

gates.definition: (Brier_best_equally_TRAIN_fitted_strong_comparator - Brier_clairvoyant_true_prior_oracle)/Brier_best_strong_comparator, measured independently for each prior×k; this is a CEILING on what any learned model could gain beyond strong comparators, not an achieved advantage.
gates.require_candidate_gain_separately: Do NOT claim a scientific positive if oracle headroom exceeds 5%; demand genuinely better held-out data-based candidate, actual parameter ablation, and complete CPU/RSS nonregression before prospective first use.
gates.no_new_scientific_source_even_if_info_bo: T40 is information audit only. Any subsequent scientific experiment needs fresh prereg, independently new source birth, exact source identity and separate trained-resource admission.
gates.failure: Retain negative and uncertainty, no repeated score optimization against this frozen exhaustive audit.
